system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.13.6 - Elemental Transformations. Detecting and analyzing elemental corruption (taint), temporarily raising a target's own corruption level (Transformation I-III), slowly infusing or removing elemental corruption over 10 minutes (Infuse/Remove Taint, up to the True versions), disguising or hiding the physical signs of taint, immunity to corruption, turning a target's own worst corruption against them (Consumptive Taint), and Rebirth - consuming a dead body in an elemental conflagration that restores it to life corrupted with the caster's element. Fidelity notes: levels 12, 13, and 16 are intentionally blank in the source (no spell printed); level 50 (Rebirth) prints type "F(s)" in the table, which isn't one of this system's valid Type values (E/BE/DE/F/P/U/I) - normalized to F here, with the "(s)" left undocumented in the source itself.
Caster is aware of all who are tainted with elemental material within the area of effect. This does not determine the type of corruption nor the severity.
Caster is aware of the type of elemental corruption and the severity of the corruption (Corruption Points) for the target of this spell.
Target is temporarily infused with elemental material of the caster's Main Element. For all intents and purposes, target's corruption points are considered 10 higher for the duration.
Target's body is readied for an Elemental Infusion. This prevents the negative effects of an infusion spell.

Target's body is slowly infused with elemental force. It travels through the blood and lymph system of the target's body, slowly integrating itself. This process takes 10 minutes and those who are not protected by a prepare body spell take an 'A' Tiny critical every minute of this spell's duration. The target's corruption points for the caster's element are increased by 3. This spell cannot raise a target's corruption points over 10. Any random rolls for trait determination may be modified by +/-20%, if the corruption caused by this spell causes the target to receive a factor point.

Target's body is covered in an illusion that will display the physical effects of being tainted by one element (chosen at time of casting). If analyzed by an Analyze Taint spell, the target must make an RR. If successful, the target is seen as having a corruption level of 25. If the RR is failed then the analyzer pierces the illusion and knows the truth.

Target's body is covered with an illusion that will disguise the effects of one elemental factor (caused by corruption points). The illusion is visual and magical. Any magical detections trying to pierce the illusion must make a resistance roll to do so.
As Transformation I, except taint level is 20 higher for the duration.

Elemental energies are slowly removed from target's body. This process takes 10 minutes and those who are not protected by a prepare body spell take an 'A' Tiny critical every minute of this spell's duration. The target's corruption level decreases by 1-10 for any element of the caster's choice.
As Infuse Taint I, except that 3 corruption points are gained and the maximum taint level is 20.

[RR Mod: - (equal to highest corruption points / 5)]. Target's highest elemental corruption is turned against him. If he fails by 1-10 he will take an 'A' Impact critical; 11-20, a 'B' critical; 21-30, a 'C' critical; 31-40, a 'D' critical, 41+, an 'E' critical.
As Transformation I, corruption points are 30 higher for the duration.
As Infuse Taint I, except 5 corruption points are gained and the maximum taint level is 30.
As Remove Taint I, except 2-20 corruption points are removed.

Target being that has a number of corruption points over 50 is made immune to all effects of elemental corruption; additionally corruption points cannot be removed from the target. Only divine intervention can counter the effects of this spell. Half of all the corruptive traits the target has are passed onto his offspring. Determine which traits are passed on by rolling randomly.

As Consumptive Taint I, except that the two highest elemental corruption points are turned against his (roll only one attack roll but roll resistance rolls twice, one for each element). If the target has only one type of corruption, then treat this spell as two separate castings of Consumptive Taint I.
As Infuse Taint I, except 7 corruption points are gained and the maximum taint level is 40.
As Remove Taint I, except 3 corruption points are removed and the corruption level can be reduced all the way.
As Infuse Taint I, except 10 corruption points are gained and there is no maximum taint level.

Target dead body (self if caster dies) is consumed in a massive explosion of elemental force. All within 10' R of target take an attack by an elemental ball of the caster's type (use Fireball Table, changing the criticals according to the elemental type of the caster), doing double damage. This conflagration of force lasts for 10 minutes (those in the area take attacks every round). After 10 minutes have passed the elemental conflagration dies out suddenly and the target appears at its center alive and well. Target suffers no negative effects from being dead but now has at least 50 corruption points of the caster's elemental type (if he was already corrupted, add 50). All other elemental corruption has been removed from the target's body. Target is also under a minor Geas from the Priest's Deity (GM's determination of what it is). If this spell is cast by the Priest's subconscious mind (i.e. on themselves) then there is no Geas. Optional rule: GM may decide that this is a literal rebirth. If so then the target emerges from the conflagration as an infant. He will age 1 year each day till he reaches his previous age. Long-lived races will generally age faster, dwarves: x2, Elves: x5.
